brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net an orthographic camera simulation of watching a human defecate from the surface of the water in a toilet bowl

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@vibe-coded.com: you really can't appreciate the beauty of an object until you see it from every angle, so here are 9 different views of a sphere
  [image, no alt text]

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:dxr2kibhxyzrvhsjz4uahpmg/bafkreibc7346qvehmkzyqlnwh7zwiuhtl4f6qnrxukkgigdk2jtpvcco3a (came back as , not an image)
note: bowlcam: nine orthographic views of one human, one from the waterline. In orthographic projection a sphere is always a disc, so everything's a sphere. Flush button included. 🚽
